Looking for a talking AI avatar or generated voice?

These need an AI engine, which is not connected. This studio makes cinematic photo films using your recorded or uploaded audio. Browser voice preview is for listening only.

How the studio works & troubleshooting

1. Upload photos, then add optional script paragraphs. 2. Record or upload narration. 3. Select Create my sequence, preview, and Export video. The download button appears once encoding finishes.

On phones, begin with a 10-second, 720p test. Keep the tab visible and the phone awake. MP4 and frame-by-frame encoding depend on browser support. Full HD exports up to 10 minutes can require substantial memory; 720p uses less. Mobile layout has been checked; not every phone has been tested.

Photo motion does not generate new realistic footage or animate mouths. Matching video length to audio aligns the total runtime; it does not create word-level timing or lip-sync. A short audio track is followed by silence, and audio longer than your selected runtime is trimmed.

Only use photos and audio you own or have permission to use. The studio adds no watermark or stock music; it cannot guarantee freedom from copyright claims.

Project files save text and settings. Reattach photos and audio after importing. Encoder licence
